data.summary: The ranged attacks of your **ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE** units, other than **WALKER** units, may re-roll a single **[Hit roll](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)** and a single **[Wound roll](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls)**.
